dedupe_keys.name: icc digital codes international codes and adopted state and local codes

description: ICC Digital Codes, from the International Code Council, describes itself as the largest provider of model codes, custom codes and standards used worldwide to construct safe, sustainable, affordable and resilient structures. It hosts the International Codes (I-Codes), headed by the International Building Code, which the ICC calls the foundation of the family of International Codes; an ICC press release of 2007 reported I-Code adoption in all 50 states and Washington, D.C. The ICC offers a small selection of codes free in a read-only format without copying, pasting or printing, and recommends its Digital Codes Premium subscriptions for a fuller library with tools such as section-level printing and an AI navigator. Coverage: model codes used across the United States. Access: free basic view after sign-up and paid Premium plans. Licence: proprietary ICC terms. Caveats: code text is copyrighted, so it cannot be bulk extracted, and local amendments change what applies at a site. Simulation uses are design rules for building archetypes and code-year assumptions in hazard fragility and resilience studies. Related records: FEMA Building Code Adoption Tracking and the Eurocodes.
